(meaning "La Amarga giant") is an extinct genus of dicraeosaurid [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/sauropod sauropod] dinosaur that lived in Argentina during the Early Cretaceous period.

page.overview:
Who is Amargatitanis?

(meaning "La Amarga giant") is an extinct genus of dicraeosaurid [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/sauropod sauropod] dinosaur that lived in Argentina during the Early Cretaceous period.

Amargatitanis is mentioned in the database of Jurassic World Evolution 2 as being a dinosaur that lived alongside Amargasaurus.

Amargatitanis once again is mentioned in the database entry for Amargasaurus in Jurassic World Evolution 3. In the database entry, it's mentioned as a dinosaur that lived alongside Amargasaurus.
